name: Overdue Aging Report
query:
SELECT
	smr.carried_by as "Employee:Link/Employee:130",
	smr.carried_by_name as "Employee Name:Data:170",
	smr.department as "Department:Link/Department:150",
	COUNT(*) as "Overdue Registers:Int:130",
	SUM(CASE WHEN smr.status = 'Escalated' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "Escalated:Int:100",
	SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), smr.expected_return_date) > 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as "15+ Days:Int:90",
	MAX(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), smr.expected_return_date)) as "Max Days Overdue:Int:140",
	ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), smr.expected_return_date)), 1) as "Avg Days Overdue:Float:140",
	GROUP_CONCAT(smr.name ORDER BY smr.expected_return_date SEPARATOR ', ') as "Gate Passes:Data:260"
FROM `tabSample Movement Register` smr
WHERE smr.docstatus = 1 AND smr.status IN ('Overdue', 'Escalated')
GROUP BY smr.carried_by, smr.carried_by_name, smr.department
ORDER BY MAX(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), smr.expected_return_date)) DESC
